saved_arithmetic_audit.scope: Saved-array arithmetic, saved Gram matrices to K/KKT/objective, metrics and registered route; no new propagation, SVD or solve.
saved_arithmetic_audit.limitation: The consumed audit did not independently rebuild feature_gram, response_gram or rhs from the saved raw train operands. That bounded arithmetic check is included in the new observer source scope; the original audit will not be rerun.

findings_supported: Both fixed-dynamics conditional encoder problems reached their unique regularized quadratic optimum to the registered numerical tolerance.
True dynamics with true hidden state predicts accurately, but true dynamics with the fitted conditional encoder still fails the clean val gate.
The registered evidence supports prioritizing initializer repair; further unconstrained encoder optimization alone is insufficient under the frozen features, penalty and train events.
Three- and eleven-frame hidden-state observation operators both have rank ten; missing rank from the three selected frames is not established.
The train feature matrix has rank 32 of 80, while the observed val energy outside its span is small; its causal share in the prediction error remains unmeasured.
causes_not_identified: A unique causal split among finite feature coverage, encoder regularization and the unconstrained mapping parameterization.
An absence of dynamics error, or success of learning dynamics with the repaired initializer.
Failure of mathematical observability or a requirement for additional hidden coordinates.

next_action.direction: Validate a fixed-dynamics discrete-history state solver using the existing eleven causal observations, followed by new registered parameter-training work only after its gates pass.

claim_boundary: Acceptance of the completed diagnostic result and its registered causal priority; no model promotion, no learned-model confirmation and no direct T0 progression.
